findings.finding: Separating sensor update cadence from physics permits controlled sample-and-hold tests; deterministic missing captures expose stale-feedback response.
findings.direction_alignment: Improve realistic physics testing while retaining independent truth
findings.opportunity_or_risk: Outage recovery must be measured from complete physics traces; slower observations must not slow the solver.
findings.engineering_cost: Add one fixed timing family, strict capture reconstruction, live readouts and a full-rate report
findings.roadmap_delta: AL-017 evaluates sample hold and bounded capture outages
findings.verification_needed: Fresh clean-revision PhysX matrix, exact ideal baseline reproduction, capture boundary tests and recovery dwell gates

overall_recommendation: Run a fixed cadence/outage study with unchanged controllers and physics.
evidence_gaps: 50 Hz and 250 ms are declared stress parameters, not hardware calibration
Attitude/rates and mission/contact sensing remain ideal
